original_local_details: R5-LOCAL-BERTH-DUTY is an original bounded local public landing function, not a detention access permit, recruited character or tower operator.
The chart binds the actual single GLIMMER, Q404 typed TechnicalHandover, original bounded E-06/E-07/E-11 validation, old_city_north_station and the exact north-station/legal-access inquiry.
Issuance requires the actual source berth, three registered cabins, physical HUB-S02 chart stand and paired safe R5-S01 public route. No weather, tide, distance or fictional sailing task is added.
Registration gives no local archive, detention access, released person, rescue result, role responsibility, final policy, reward or future document.
The original R4 handover retains unknown current Mara status. The real R5 rescue and the separately sourced responsibilities remain actual later operations.
